text: Residents of Jeavons Avenue have provided a petition signed by residents on the street requesting that the current one-hour parking maximum be rescinded and replaced with the City-wide standard three-hour default parking by-law. The current one-hour maximum is unsuitable for residents and their visitors.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum one-hour maximum parking limit in effect at all times on the west side of Jeavons Avenue, between Raleigh Avenue and the north end of Jeavons Avenue.
